description: Entity extraction schema for historical and hagiographic texts, distinguishing persons, groups, institutions, places, objects, and divine entities.

is_related_to.description: Connects two people who have a personal or familial relationship.

goes_to.description: Connects a person or group of people to a place or institution that they travel, move, or are going to.

comes_from.description: Connects a person to the place or institution where they originate, were born, or previously lived.

resides_at.description: Connects a person to the place or institution where they live or reside.

owns.description: Connects a person or group of people to an object that they own, possess, wear, carry, use.

is_owned_by.description: Connects a body (part) to the person who it belongs to.

is_located_at.description: Connects an institution, organization or object to the place where it is physically situated.
